Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop exercise

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. As part of our SOC 2 readiness and internal third-party review, Horizon needs a short catalogue of your BCP/DR evidence focused on RTO/RPO controls and a 90-minute tabletop exercise to validate failover decisioning. Specifically we are requesting:

- Current RTO/RPO attestation and the matrix per service/component (application, DB, cache, replay queues)
- Backup configuration snapshot (retention, replication, encryption at rest)
- Latest DR runbook and escalation matrix
- Evidence of most recent DR test (date, scope, outcomes)
- Proposed 90–120 minute tabletop scenarios and available dates

Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD PT Monday (Oct 12) and propose two 90-minute slots next week for the tabletop (we prefer mornings PST)? If you have links to a shared drive or a short packet we can review that would be great.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Third-Party Risk Analyst
Horizon Bank

P.S. SOC review team copied in case they want to add artifacts: soc-review@thirdparty-audit.com

Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. I attached a concise evidence packet and the proposed tabletop plan. High-level notes below; see attachments for details.

Attachments (in this thread):
- rto_rpo_matrix_v1.pdf (RTO/RPO per service, last updated 2026-09-20)
- dr_runbook_v2.docx (runbook with escalation contacts and recovery steps)
- tabletop-test-plan.xlsx (90-min plan with scenarios, owners, and recovery checkpoints)
- backup-config-snapshot.tar.gz (config snapshot of backups and retention policy)

Availability for tabletop (PST):
- Option A: Tue Oct 14, 09:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed Oct 15, 10:30–12:00

Quick summary: our targeted RTOs are 1–4 hours depending on component; typical RPO is 15 minutes for primary DB, <1 hour for async replicas, 0–4 hours for non-critical services. We perform weekly incremental backups and monthly full snapshots, encrypted at rest with AES-256 and KMS-managed keys.

If you want a pre-read walkthrough before the tabletop, I can schedule a 30‑minute call.

—
Priyom Das
Senior Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop exercise — technical addendum

Priyom / Lena,

Adding a few technical detail points to the packet so Horizon's reviewers have the context they typically ask for:

- Backup topology: primary-region persistent volumes + cross-region async replication to a cold region. Snapshot cadence: full monthly + daily incremental; DB WAL shipping retained for 14 days.
- RPO/RTO rationale: primary DB RPO targets 15m via WAL streaming; failover automation is manual for DB (rationalized for stability) with runbook checklists targeting 1 hour to promote replicas and verify catch-up.
- KV cache (in-memory) is treated as ephemeral; caches are rebuilt from primary sources; RTO target for cache warm-up is 30–60 minutes depending on index size.
- Telemetry and alerting: we have a 'service-degradation' runbook that triggers notification flow to SRE on-call, product owner, and security; audit logs are retained 365 days.
- Recent test evidence: included minimal redaction logs from the June 2026 DR drill and failover checklist outputs.

If it helps, I can extract a short appendix with the exact commands and timestamps we used in the June 2026 run; that would be a separate sanitized artifact.

-Karthik
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: backup-config-snapshot.tar.gz (contains config files and retention policy snapshots)
